errors.text: The proposed compositions and particle sizes differ substantially from the sub-10 nm equiatomic AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles, eliminating the Au/Cu-specific surface segregation and volatility central to the target behavior.
The predicted endpoint emphasizes bulk-like phase decomposition into ordered intermetallics or elemental clusters rather than surface segregation followed by Au/Cu shell melting and evaporation.

The long-duration 800 °C annealing experiment does not reconstruct the in situ 298–973 K heating protocol and cannot directly resolve the coupled diffusion, reshaping, segregation, and evaporation sequence.
